subject.title: [Feature]: Non-interactive command to use Codex OAuth for model provider

question: Should OpenClaw support non-interactive OpenAI ChatGPT/Codex OAuth setup, and which OAuth handoff shape is acceptable for automation users?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but selecting callback URL, token import, or upstream app-server login semantics changes credential handling and must be a maintainer-owned security/product decision.

options.title: Design provider-owned handoff
options.body: Add the feature only after maintainers choose a validated OpenAI-plugin-owned callback/token contract with redaction, docs, and security tests.

options.title: Accept env callback URL
options.body: Implement the requested env-style callback URL import directly with strict validation and documented exposure tradeoffs.

options.title: Defer to current flows
options.body: Keep interactive browser, device-code, and API-key setup as the supported automation surfaces until Codex exposes a stable external auth contract.

recommendation.title: Design provider-owned handoff
recommendation.body: Add the feature only after maintainers choose a validated OpenAI-plugin-owned callback/token contract with redaction, docs, and security tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal ties this product/security choice to OpenAI provider unification and non-interactive provider setup work.
